dedupe_keys.name: on site monitoring of the moisture content of bridge decks made of nail laminated timbers

description: On-site monitoring of the moisture content of bridge decks made of nail-laminated timbers is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by WANRONG ZHU, University of New Brunswick Saint John (unb.ca). This study summarizes the moisture content (MC) monitoring results of two nail-laminated timber (NLT) bridge decks in New Brunswick, Canada. The MC monitoring systems were installed in the NLT decks of two newly-built bridges, Clark Mill Pond and Shikatehawk No.5, in New Brunswick, recording the MC through Electrical Resistance (ER) method. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Timber bridge decks, Nail-laminated timber, Moisture content, Long-term monitoring, Calibration. Published 2019-12-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
